entities.name: Gilbert Gérintès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gilbert Gérintès was a French rugby union player who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. In 1924, he won the silver medal as member of the French team. He played three Test matches between 1924 and 1926, as well as two Five Nations Championship matches in 1925 and 1926.
